content:
Autism Sanctuary is growing rapidly! To support this exciting expansion, we’re thrilled to welcome two new full-time team members in the upcoming months. Isabelle (Izzy) Kueser (isabelle@autismsanctuary.org) and Lyla Mae Zinn (lyla@autismsanctuary.org). Their talent, energy, and passion leave Autism Sanctuary well-positioned to continue thriving.

With this new help, Autism Sanctuary hopes to implement Mondays into the Day Program schedule, conduct more extensive research and data collection, enhance the overall quality of our community outings, and so much more. 

Don’t forget: Autism Sanctuary currently offers:

  • Group Day services, offering fulfillment each day through farm work and hands-on activities.
  • Community Engagement services, providing one-on-one support and guidance when navigating new social spaces. 
  • Sponsored Residential services, bringing care and support into the homes of individuals. We have plans to expand home services with our first group homes! Priority placement will go to current Autism Sanctuary clients, starting with those receiving residential services, followed by group day and community engagement participants.

If any of these services sound like they may be of interest to friends that you know, please spread the word! As we continue to grow, we would appreciate your help encouraging families in need to join our waitlist. Don't hesitate to reach out if you’re curious about service eligibility or want to explore new options. This growth reflects your trust and support, and we’re thrilled to continue expanding access.
